title: 주말 계획 이야기: 맑으면 좋겠어요, 비만 아니면…
objective: By the end, you can use -(으)면 좋겠어요 with verbs, adjectives and nouns to state a hope. You can also use N만 아니면 to name the one thing that is stopping a plan.
summary: Learn to say what you hope for with -(으)면 좋겠다 and what is stopping you with N만 아니면.

task.title: Hopes and obstacles
task.line: Use -(으)면 좋겠어요 to say what you hope for, and N만 아니면 to name the one thing in the way.

forms.form: Stem ending in a vowel or ㄹ + -면 좋겠다
forms.when: With verbs and adjectives whose stem ends in a vowel. A ㄹ stem also just adds -면 (살다 → 살면).
forms.means: I hope ~ / It would be nice if ~
forms.exampleMeaning: I hope the weather is cool this weekend.

forms.form: Stem ending in a consonant + -으면 좋겠다
forms.when: With stems ending in a consonant (not ㄹ). Watch out for irregular verbs and adjectives: 가깝다 → 가까우면, 듣다 → 들으면.
forms.means: I hope ~ / It would be nice if ~
forms.example: 회사 근처에 맛있는 식당이 있으면 좋겠어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: It would be nice if there were a good restaurant near the office.

forms.when: With a noun. After a consonant use 이면, and after a vowel use 면.
When one thing (N) is stopping something you could otherwise do. The second half says what would be possible.
forms.means: If it weren't for N, ~ / If only there were no N, ~
forms.example: 숙제만 아니면 오늘 같이 놀 수 있어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: If it weren't for my homework, I could hang out with you today.

watchOut: 먹면 좋겠어요 (X) → 먹으면 좋겠어요 (O): after a consonant stem, add 으.
덥으면 (X) → 더우면 (O): with ㅂ-irregular words, ㅂ changes to 우.
날씨가 맑고 싶어요 (X) → 날씨가 맑으면 좋겠어요 (O): -고 싶다 is only for your own actions. To hope for something about the weather or other people, use -(으)면 좋겠다.
비가만 아니면 (X) → 비만 아니면 (O): put 만 right after the noun, with no 이/가.
exercises: Choose the correct form: ① 방이 좀 더 (넓면 / 넓으면) 좋겠어요. ② 동생이 서울에서 같이 (살으면 / 살면) 좋겠어요. ③ 가방이 좀 더 (가볍으면 / 가벼우면) 좋겠어요.
Complete each sentence with -(으)면 좋겠어요: ① 내일 회의가 일찍 (끝나다) ____. ② 다음 주 월요일이 (휴일) ____.
Fill in the blank with the word in brackets + 만 아니면: (회의) ____ 지금 전화를 받을 수 있어요.
Join the two sentences into one with 만 아니면: 아르바이트가 있어요. 그래서 토요일 모임에 못 가요.
A mother is talking about her child. Find and fix the mistake: 아이가 밥을 잘 먹고 싶어요.
answers: ① 넓으면 ② 살면 ③ 가벼우면
① 끝나면 좋겠어요 ② 휴일이면 좋겠어요
아르바이트만 아니면 토요일 모임에 갈 수 있어요. (also correct: 토요일 모임에 아르바이트만 아니면 갈 수 있어요.)
